model: Siemens LMV5 Steam Boiler with BACnet Interface
applies_to: Fulton steam boilers whose Siemens LMV5 burner management is given a BACnet interface (standard configurations).
summary: Fulton lists 26 Analog Value objects (integer values) for a steam boiler with a Siemens LMV5 burner control on a BACnet interface. Objects 1-19 are read-only: fuel, output, setpoint, actual pressure, flame signal, units, error code and modes. Objects 20-26 are the writable copies of the mode, output and setpoint values.
notes: All objects are Analog Values with integer values; on/off and mode values are codes.
Objects 10 and 11 are printed with the names "35" and "37" and no range; object 11 has no read/write mark (listed here as read-only).
The sheet does not say which gateway or transport is used.

integration.summary: Write Modbus Mode = Remote (AV 21), then use Operating Mode in Remote (AV 22: Auto, Remote On, Remote Off) and the setpoint or output objects. Read current output, actual pressure, flame signal and the error code. AV 1-19 are read-only copies; the writable versions are AV 20-26.

minimum_points.name: Modbus Mode
minimum_points.why: Set 1 = Remote so network commands take effect

integration.enable: AV 21 Modbus Mode = 1 (Remote) hands control to the network; AV 22 Operating Mode in Remote then selects 0 = Auto, 1 = Remote On or 2 = Remote Off. AV 23 Predefined Output Modulation sets the output (200-1000) and AV 24-26 are the writable setpoints W3, W1 and W2.
setup: The sheet gives no device instance, MAC address or baud rate.
gotchas: Every object is an Analog Value carrying integers, including on/off and mode codes.
AV 1-19 are read-only; write to AV 20-26 instead.
Pressure units on the setpoints follow AV 8 Unit of Pressure (0 = bar, 1 = psi); the sheet labels them psi.
